Data:Bed.rest.memory.weather.hint.json.label: Dream on a Memory?
Data:Bed.rest.memory.weather.hint.json.startdescription: Once night has fallen, I can rest - and perhaps dream on the day's doings. [Dreaming on most Memories will preserve them past Dawn - but Weather Memories can't be used in this way.]

Data:Beef.json.Label: Beef
Data:Beef.json.Desc: [Roast it, or perhaps marinate it first - if you have something Intoxicating for the marinade.]

xexts.scrutiny:
The more one looks at meat, the less one generally wants to eat it. And the more one listens to it. Meat.
Meat.

Data:Beef.marinated.json.Label: Marinated Beef (Uncooked)
Data:Beef.marinated.json.Desc: Tangy with the harbingers of a roastful destiny.

xexts.scrutiny: When one understands the distinction between 'marinate' and 'marinade', there is no limit to one's power to irritate the innocent.

Data:Beef.roast.json.Label: Roast Beef
Data:Beef.roast.json.Desc: Our fathers of old were robust, stout, and strong, And kept open house, with good cheer all day long, Which made their plump tenants rejoice in this song— Oh! The Roast Beef of old England, And old English Roast Beef! - Henry Fielding, The Grub Street Opera

Data:Beef.roast.marinated.json.Label: Marinated Roast Beef
Data:Beef.roast.marinated.json.Desc: But since we have learnt from all-vapouring France To eat their ragouts as well as to dance, We're fed up with nothing but vain complaisance Oh! the Roast Beef of Old England, And old English Roast Beef! - Henry Fielding, The Grub Street Opera

Data:Beeswax.json.Label: Beeswax
Data:Beeswax.json.Desc: It begins as a flower. [Beeswax can be used to make candles, if you have a skill with the Chandlery aspect.]

Data:Beverage.json.label: Beverage
Data:Beverage.json.desc: There are some things it's wiser to drink in the morning... and others it's wiser to drink in the evening.

Data:Beverage.raveline.json.label: Beverage: Raveline
Data:Beverage.raveline.json.desc: [Invisible marker aspect for the various Raveline wine objects]

Data:Bisclavrets.knot.json.Label: Bisclavret's Knot
Data:Bisclavrets.knot.json.Desc: The bisclavret is the half-human hill-child of these parts, and this is its sign.

xexts.scrutiny: The wind howls… [Certain Prentice-level Scale recipes are used to tie the Knot.]

Data:Bittersweet.certainty.json.Label: Bittersweet Certainty
Data:Bittersweet.certainty.json.Desc: Eventually, the Sun-in-Rags always brings its beautiful ending.

Data:Black.sapphire.wash.json.Label: Black Sapphire Wash
Data:Black.sapphire.wash.json.Desc: The colour, perhaps, of the doors of the House of the Moon.

xexts.scrutiny: 'When the light is extinguished, the shadow persists. After the House of the Sun, the House of the Moon.' [There are Keeper-level Moon recipes which can create this from Asimel.]
Sweet and tangy. [If you're looking for more Blackberries, they can sometimes be found on the Moor in summer and autumn.]

Data:Block.numa.json.label: Numa Not Yet
Data:Block.numa.json.desc: Prevents Numa being drawn for a while - one of these should be purged each numa draw.

Data:Blue.crown.json.Label: Blue Crown
Data:Blue.crown.json.Desc: The sky-coloured petals of blue crown are always cold as frost.

xexts.scrutiny: Solomon Husher often used this in his preparations.

Data:Bolt.linen.json.Label: Bolt of Buttercup Linen
Data:Bolt.linen.json.Desc: Suitable for a summer suit or an altar-veil.

xexts.scrutiny: This is the colour that an Undivided Afternoon would choose to be.

Data:Bolt.silk.json.Label: Bolt of Pale Silk
Data:Bolt.silk.json.Desc: Suitable for handkerchiefs or anbaric experiments.

xexts.scrutiny: This is the colour that the snow before spring would choose to be.
